title: pH on the Edge
threat: A remote-support session through the unapproved DosaTech ScreenBridge agent on MBW-HMI-02 in the Chemical Building results in a stepwise increase of the NAOH-FC-203 caustic dose setpoint toward the PLC hard limit of 40 mg/L. The HMI displays normal operation, but field instruments (AIT-302, PSH-302) and grab samples indicate finished-water pH is rising toward 9.5, creating a mismatch between screen and reality. This cyber-physical compromise of the chemical feed system triggers a public health emergency.
location: Riverside Water Treatment Plant, Millbrook, Carver County, Ohio
roles: ops: Director of Water Operations (Incident Commander)
it: SCADA / IT Security Manager (Technical Lead)
regulator: Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District (Regulator Liaison)
